rules: D is the physical target day: endpoints D 01:00 through D+1 00:00 KST.
Both rounds are issued no later than D-1 17:00 KST. Freeze this issue bundle.
For canonical mappings see official README: humidity maps wa_humidity/wb_rel_hum.
Forecast NaNs remain NaN. No zero-fill of missing weather or missing truth.
For centered windows require all three contiguous slots inside the same target-day issue bundle; otherwise derived statistic is NaN.
For day aggregates require complete source fields and q; otherwise aggregate is NaN. No skipping absent timestamps in step differences.
Six-hour windows do not borrow later-issued neighboring-day forecasts. Incomplete windows are NaN.
Negative invalid rain, snow and wind become NaN before proxy construction. No simulated snowpack or true module temperature is claimed.
No test-period global moments, actual target SMP/weather, raw coordinates, site ID or current group as features.
Both models receive the same 160 columns; station identifiers are categorical; model-internal encoding dimensions are not additional features.
